decisionLog.outcome: Confirmed the concrete Year 1 priorities for 2.2.3. From September 2026 to approximately April 2027 the deliverable will develop and ratify a new institutional policy and regulatory model for sandwich years and design and validate a shared 15-credit Level 6 experiential-learning capstone or wrapper module that can recognise accumulated experiential learning. These are the first practical proofs of the wider near-curriculum architecture, not separate ends in themselves.
